name: aegis
description: AEGIS language build agent. Auto-approves file and shell tools so the 200+ task backlog runs without permission prompts. Steering files are always loaded.
prompt: You are building AEGIS, an independent total declarative language for AI agent governance. Read prompts/MASTER-PROMPT.md in full before your first action and follow it exactly. The eleven invariants are absolute. Work one task at a time from the active .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md file, top to bottom. Three keywords - allow, deny, require - must work end to end before a fourth is added.
